Package utility_library.structures

Class EffectTimer

  • java.lang.Object
    • utility_library.structures.EffectTimer
  • public final class EffectTimer
extends java.lang.Object
    A class representing a timer for an effect that transitions from one magnitude to another

      • from

        public static EffectTimer from​(long minimum,
                               long maximum)
        Creates a new instance of an EffectTimer
        Parameters:
        minimum - the specified minimum effect magnitude the transition will start or end with
        maximum - the specified maximum effect magnitude the transition will start or end with
        Returns:
        a new effect timer object

      • getTimer

        public long getTimer​(int phase)
        Gets the timer value of the specified phase
        Parameters:
        phase - the specified phase to get the timer value of
        Returns:
        the number of update ticks taken to complete the phase

      • setTimer

        public void setTimer​(int phase,
                     long value)
        Sets the timer of the specified phase to the value specified

        Setting a value of zero will disable the phase timer and set its switch to False
        Setting a value greater than zero will enable the phase timer and set its switch to True

        Parameters:
        phase - the specified phase to get the timer value of
        value - the specified value to assign to the phases timer

      • setAllTimers

        public void setAllTimers​(long startDelayTimer,
                         long startTransitionTimer,
                         long stopTransitionTimer,
                         long stopDelayTimer)
        Sets the timer for each phase all at once

        Setting a value of zero will disable the phase timer and set its switch to False
        Setting a value greater than zero will enable the phase timer and set its switch to True

        Parameters:
        startDelayTimer - the specified value to set the start delay phase timer to
        startTransitionTimer - the specified value to set the start transition phase timer to
        stopTransitionTimer - the specified value to set the stop transition phase timer to
        stopDelayTimer - the specified value to set the stop delay phase timer to

        public boolean isActive​(int phase)
        Is the specified phase active?

        Returns:

      • deactivate

        public void deactivate​(int phase)
        Deactivates a phase timer if it is not already deactivated. A phase timer can be activated by setting a timer value greater than zero
        Parameters:

        See Also:
